description: This file is a PHP web page that manages cordless handsets, including displaying connected handsets, enabling/disabling CAT-iq, registering/deregistering handsets, and handling related user interactions with embedded JavaScript.

methods.name: init_data
methods.description: Initializes the handset data table and UI elements based on server-side data.

methods.name: ajax_do
methods.description: Performs an AJAX POST request to update handset settings or deregister a handset.
